notes: This minor release requires Bifrost 0.15.1 or later and depends exactly on bifrost.public.packs 0.12.0. It makes the default rules catalog load on released Bifrost engines again. Released engines through 0.15.2 reject the whole catalog for either of two defects present since rules 0.10.0: a directory under the rules root without manifest.json, and a policy whose required_capabilities list is empty ("incomplete inventory metadata"). It moves the staged rules/bifrost.rust-codeql-security catalogs (#326), which registered no policy, to research/rust-codeql-security. It holds out the opt-in policy bifrost.security.rust.cargo-ssh-git-host-key-unverified (#248), which declares no required capability, by moving it with its fixtures and qualification to research/rust-cargo-ssh-git; bifrost.security becomes 3.0.0. The policy returns in a rules release that requires an engine accepting an empty required_capabilities list (bifrost-dev#10941). No other policy, ID, finding or required capability changes from rules 0.12.0. This release does not qualify the full policy set or imply complete analysis.
